_fixture.source: contract fixture: built by a development script (not in the repository) from the design draft overlay and research copies, in the shapes of the design's contract (now the types in lib/endpoints/controls.ts). Not a server answer.

intro: Open Controls, then your wheel's preset. F1 25 groups the actions as Control Scheme, MFD Shortcuts and UDP Custom Actions.
The game's preset for this wheel may already use this button (EA doesn't publish the GT DD Pro defaults).

steps.label: DRS / active aero
steps.note: F1 25 shares this button with the pit limiter by default.

steps.label: Pit limiter
steps.note: Same button as DRS: pit limiter in the pit lane, DRS on track.

steps.label: Talk to Pitwall
steps.note: Pitwall listens for this one. Back out to the garage or menu, then test it.

outro: Open Test and press each one once.
If a button already did something else, F1 25 may have moved or dropped that action: check the list once more.
